Biomarkers

- I ran the initial cleaned script for
  [EDA](https://github.com/ChrisMantegna/mytilus_biomarkers) with
  success, made notes on what I want to adjust and clearly documented
  the result on the raw data. I didn't remove or transform any data for
  this run.

- The purpose of this is to clarify my outliers and/ or transformation
  decisions that I did not clearly document the first time.

- Next steps, replace all SOD values below the limit of quantification
  (LOQ), and run it again. Any values below 0.025 will be replaced with
  0.025 as standard practice is to replace with half of the test's
  lowest limit; in this case, the Cayman SOD kit cannot reliably detect
  below 0.05, and since all samples were run in duplicate with protein
  quantification before assay prep, it is safe to determine that any
  activity below the LOQ is not technical in source, but biological in
  response.
